title: Idiosyncrasies in Large Language Models
authors: Mingjie Sun, Yida Yin, Zhiqiu Xu, J. Zico Kolter, Zhuang Liu
what_it_shows: Fine-tuning text embeddings on LLM outputs achieves 97.1% 5-way model attribution accuracy that persists through rewriting and translation.

title: Who's Behind the Text? Robust Model Authorship Attribution
authors: Minseok Ko, Hyunseok Lee, Woomin Song, Beomjun Kim, Jinwoo Shin, Kunwoong Kim
what_it_shows: Introduces ATLAS using LoRA-adapted source-conditioned language modeling and token likelihoods to attribute text across domain and model version shifts.

title: How Is ChatGPT's Behavior Changing over Time?
authors: Lingjiao Chen, Matei Zaharia, James Zou
what_it_shows: Evaluates March vs June 2023 snapshots of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, finding dramatic behavioral and performance drifts in math, coding, and safety refusals.

title: Model Equality Testing: Which Model Is This API Serving?
authors: Irena Gao, Percy Liang, Carlos Guestrin
what_it_shows: Formulates two-sample hypothesis testing using MMD on string kernels to detect when commercial inference APIs secretly modify or quantize served weights compared to reference models.

title: Are You Getting What You Pay For? Auditing Model Substitution in LLM APIs
authors: Will Cai, Tianneng Shi, Xuandong Zhao, Dawn Song
what_it_shows: Analyzes the economic model substitution problem in LLM APIs and evaluates the failure modes of software-only statistical auditing vs hardware TEEs.

title: Authorship Attribution in the Era of LLMs: Problems, Methodologies, and Challenges
authors: Baixiang Huang, Canyu Chen, Kai Shu
what_it_shows: Surveys LLM-generated text detection, attribution across architectures, and human-machine co-authorship while emphasizing open challenges in out-of-domain generalization.

title: Leakage in Data Mining: Formulation, Detection, and Avoidance
authors: Shachar Kaufman, Saharon Rosset, Claudia Perlich, Ori Stitelman
what_it_shows: Establishes foundational concepts of data leakage where preprocessing or split violations cause artificially inflated cross-validation performance that collapses in production.

title: Return of Frustratingly Easy Domain Adaptation
authors: Baochen Sun, Jiashi Feng, Kate Saenko
what_it_shows: Proposes CORAL to align source and target feature covariance matrices for unsupervised domain adaptation.

title: Leakage and the Reproducibility Crisis in ML-based Science
what_it_shows: Surveys data leakage across scientific fields, showing how group dependency violations in cross-validation systematically produce non-reproducible overoptimistic gains.

title: Comprehensive 1st Place Write-Up
authors: Nicholas Broad, Udbhav Bamba, Raja Biswas
what_it_shows: Winner of the 2024 Kaggle AI text detection competition demonstrates that scale and diversity of generated data matter far more than model architecture for private test generalization.

title: DAIGT V2 Train Dataset & GroupKFold Discussion
what_it_shows: Explains that random CV splits yield illusory 0.999 AUC by memorizing prompt topics, requiring GroupKFold by prompt to evaluate true generalization.

title: The Topic Confusion Task: A Novel Scenario for Authorship Attribution
authors: Malik H. Altakrori, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung, Benjamin C. M. Fung
what_it_shows: Demonstrates that pre-trained language models exploit topical shortcuts in authorship attribution, failing when author-topic mappings are swapped between train and test.

title: Silent Updates: Measuring and Closing the Post-Deployment Disclosure Gap
what_it_shows: Measures the post-deployment disclosure gap across 16 API providers and hosts, finding no verifiable mechanisms to confirm served model identity.

title: Token-Efficient Change Detection in LLM APIs
authors: Timothée Chauvin, Clément Lalanne, Erwan Le Merrer, Jean-Michel Loubes, François Taïani, Gilles Tredan
what_it_shows: Uses output token phase transitions on border inputs to detect silent LLM API updates at 30x lower query cost in a black-box setting.

title: Who Built This Model? Tracing LLM Lineage via Spectral Fingerprints in Weight Space
authors: Yiwei Chen, Bingqi Shang, Sijia Liu
what_it_shows: Traces open-weight LLM lineage, model families, and post-training ancestry through spectral energy and subspace alignment in weight space without text data.

title: Detecting Stylistic Fingerprints of Large Language Models
authors: Yehonatan Bitton, Elad Bitton, Shai Nisan
what_it_shows: Shows that ensemble classifiers can detect persistent stylistic fingerprints across major commercial LLM families (Claude, Gemini, Llama, OpenAI).

title: FDLLM: A Dedicated Detector for Black-Box LLMs Fingerprinting
authors: Zhiyuan Fu, Junfan Chen, et al.
what_it_shows: Uses LoRA on Qwen2.5 to capture subtle rhythmic and stylistic fingerprints of 20 LLMs in black-box multi-domain text.

title: Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation
authors: Adaku Uchendu, Thai Le, Kai Shu, Dongwon Lee
what_it_shows: Defines the multi-class authorship attribution task for machine-generated texts across neural text generators.
